verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Realtime's SFU has a first-party WebRTC-to-WebSocket adapter. It streams live call audio as PCM to any WebSocket server while the call runs, and the docs include a Workers AI transcription example with speech sent back through media adapters. Temporary disconnects get retries, and a managed transcription option is also offered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of live streaming to a model endpoint, and detailed docs on audio format specifics and latency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running

citations.quote: Any server that accepts WebSockets, such as a Durable Object, can receive live call audio as PCM samples and video as JPEG frames without implementing a WebRTC client.
Transcribe microphone audio with Workers AI, then send generated speech to browsers through WebSocket media adapters.
For WebRTC-to-WebSocket streaming, the SFU retries the same endpoint for up to 15 seconds after a temporary disconnect.
